setup:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH="$(uv tool dir --bin):$PATH"
export MAX_JOBS=2
COURT_PROBE_OUTPUT="$1"
COURT_PROBE_TIMER=knowledge/runs/run-court-scale-pilot-l4-20261023/timed_command.py
COURT_PROBE_ASSETS=data/synthetic_data_generation/court-scene-assets-v1-a9281d9a41e39fc9-verified
mkdir -p "$COURT_PROBE_OUTPUT/setup" tmp
git rev-parse HEAD
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,driver_version,memory.total --format=csv,noheader
python3 "$COURT_PROBE_TIMER" --receipt "$COURT_PROBE_OUTPUT/setup/uv.json" -- uv sync --locked
python3 "$COURT_PROBE_TIMER" --receipt "$COURT_PROBE_OUTPUT/setup/nht.json" -- .venv/bin/python -m spin setup-nht --render-only
python3 "$COURT_PROBE_TIMER" --receipt "$COURT_PROBE_OUTPUT/setup/asset-download.json" -- .venv/bin/python .agents/skills/tennis-drive/scripts/drive.py download "$COURT_PROBE_ASSETS" "$COURT_PROBE_ASSETS" --verify
python3 "$COURT_PROBE_TIMER" --receipt "$COURT_PROBE_OUTPUT/setup/asset-verify.json" -- .venv/bin/python -m src.synthetic_data_generation.scripts.court_scene_assets verify --root "$COURT_PROBE_ASSETS" --manifest-sha256 a9281d9a41e39fc944e684f7bdeb5b3517cb9424b297d318a557bcb263e8009b
render-probe:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH="$(uv tool dir --bin):$PATH"
export PYTHONPATH="$PWD"
COURT_PROBE_OUTPUT="$1"
COURT_PROBE_TIMER=knowledge/runs/run-court-scale-pilot-l4-20261023/timed_command.py
test ! -e "$COURT_PROBE_OUTPUT/probe"
.venv/bin/python "$COURT_PROBE_TIMER" --receipt "$COURT_PROBE_OUTPUT/render-timing.json" --sample-gpu -- .venv/bin/python -m cProfile -o "$COURT_PROBE_OUTPUT/profile.pstats" knowledge/runs/run-court-d2-support-cpu-20261024/render_probe.py --selection knowledge/runs/run-court-d2-support-cpu-20261024/render-selection.json --asset-root data/synthetic_data_generation/court-scene-assets-v1-a9281d9a41e39fc9-verified --output "$COURT_PROBE_OUTPUT/probe"
.venv/bin/python - "$COURT_PROBE_OUTPUT" <<'PY'
import json
import pstats
import sys
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(sys.argv[1])
stats = pstats.Stats(str(root / "profile.pstats"))
names = {"evaluate_render", "encode_rgb_jpeg", "savez_compressed", "atomic_json", "reconstruct", "load_scene_inputs", "__call__", "_invoke", "validate", "wait", "_savez", "run", "write_bytes", "rename", "file_sha256"}
rows = [
    {"file": key[0], "line": key[1], "function": key[2], "primitive_calls": value[0], "calls": value[1], "self_seconds": value[2], "cumulative_seconds": value[3]}
    for key, value in stats.stats.items()
    if key[2] in names
]
temporary = root / "profile-summary.partial"
temporary.write_text(json.dumps({"total_seconds": stats.total_tt, "rows": rows}, indent=2) + "\n")
temporary.rename(root / "profile-summary.json")
PY
collect-review:
set -euo pipefail
export PYTHONPATH="$PWD"
.venv/bin/python knowledge/runs/run-court-d2-probe-l4-20261024/collect_probe.py --root "$1"
mkdir "$1/recovery"
mv "$1/review.tar" "$1/recovery/review.tar"
mv "$1/review-manifest.json" "$1/recovery/review-manifest.json"
